subject: Disputed streaming attribution — request for per-request token breakdown
messages:
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@mosaicai.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.example>
Cc: billing@mosaicai.com
Date: Tue, 07 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Unexpected charge — streaming attribution appears doubled

Hi Tessa,

We just received the June invoice (invoice-20260630.pdf attached) and noticed a large overage line attributed to streaming embed requests. Our internal usage dashboard shows ~1.1M chunks sent, but Redwood billed for ~2.3M per-token units. Can you help reconcile why the billed token count is roughly double what we expect?

I've attached a CSV with a sample of request_ids (raw-request-ids.csv) and a small telemetry snippet where we see the client only sending single-chunk streams for these requests. The overage line is ~12,400 tokens which is material for our budgeting.

Two specific asks:
- Can you provide a per-request_id token breakdown (inbound vs generated) and the billing attribution window used?
- Can you hold any collection on that overage while we validate?

We appreciate a quick turnaround — cc'd billing for visibility.

Thanks,
Jordan
Director of Platform, MosaicAI
Jordan Lee | jordan.lee@mosaicai.com

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.example>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@mosaicai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example>
Date: Tue, 07 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected charge — streaming attribution appears doubled

Jordan — thanks for the heads up and for sending the sample IDs. We've opened a quick internal audit to trace how those request_ids were counted. High level notes: Redwood's billing counts inbound tokens + model-generated tokens; for streaming embeddings we count per chunk as the chunk is finalized and bill against the compute node that accepted the request. There are a couple of edge cases that can inflate counts (client retries, chunking boundary rounding, and prefix-cache misses).

Action plan: 
1) Ben will pull the server-side request logs and a per-request token tally for the request_ids you attached.
2) We'll check whether any of the request_ids had duplicate ingestion events or retry signatures (X-Request-Retry headers).
3) If we find a billing-side duplication, we will hold collection and apply a retroactive credit.

Please hold off on payment actions for the disputed line for 72 hours while we complete the audit. I'll follow up with the breakdown by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.example>, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@mosaicai.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Jul 2026 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected charge — streaming attribution appears doubled

Jordan / Tessa — I pulled the telemetry for the 10 sample request_ids. Quick findings: 3 of the 10 show duplicate accept events within a 12s window on different front-end nodes (likely retries), and 2 show chunk-splits where the client sent a trailing empty chunk and our chunk-finalizer counted an extra token for the finalization marker. The attached sample-telemetry-snippet.txt has the raw headers and token counts per accept.

Notes on counting behavior so you can cross-check: 
- Inbound tokens = tokens in the request payload as parsed by our tokenizer.
- Generated tokens = model outputs; streaming flushes are counted when segments are finalized.
- Retry dedup window = 15s (we mark duplicate request_id accepts within that window for review but they currently still appear in raw tallies prior to dedupe job).

Next steps: I can produce a CSV with the per-request breakdown (server_received_tokens, model_generated_tokens, node_id, accept_timestamp) for the full set you provided. If you prefer an immediate short credit for the 3 confirmed duplicate accepts and 2 finalization markers, we can issue a provisional credit while we continue the full run.

Ben
Billing Ops Lead | Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@mosaicai.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.example>
Cc: billing@mosaicai.com
Date: Thu, 09 Jul 2026 11:09:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected charge — streaming attribution appears doubled

Thanks Ben — that explanation is helpful and aligns with what we suspected (retries from our edge during an incident). We do have an incident on Jun 29 that triggered repeated client reconnects; happy to share correlation logs if that helps. Please do the per-request CSV for the full set (we sent ~8,500 request_ids in the batch) and confirm the provisional credit amount you'd suggest for the 5 impacted samples extrapolated proportionally.

Also — please confirm you're placing a temporary hold on collection for the disputed line. We need that in writing for our finance team before we escalate internally.

—Jordan

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.example>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@mosaicai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example>, billing@mosaicai.com
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected charge — streaming attribution appears doubled

Jordan — confirming: Redwood has placed the disputed overage line (invoice 20260630, line item "Streaming Embeds — overage") on temporary hold. We will not proceed with collection while the audit is open. Ben will deliver the per-request CSV by end of day (I've asked for node_id + accept_timestamp + inbound_tokens + generated_tokens + dedupe_flag).

Preliminary provisional credit: based on the sample extrapolation Ben proposed, we are provisionally crediting 12,200 tokens (~$48.80) pending the full audit. If the audit changes that amount materially we will adjust and notify you; retroactive credits are supported.

I've logged this externally: HubSpot ref https://hubspot.example/contacts/98123 and JIRA SUP-1234. Once the CSV is published to the Drive link (https://drive.redwood/support/mosaicai/token-logs) I'll cc your finance contact and close the temporary hold.

Let us know if you want a short web call to walk through the logs — we can schedule 30m tomorrow.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: invoice-20260630.pdf (pdf), raw-request-ids.csv (csv), sample-telemetry-snippet.txt (text)
